```{python}
#| echo: false
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd


def check_exists(path):
    path = Path(path)

    if not path.exists():
        print(f"ERROR: Could not find resource: {path}")
        print("Please check that:")
        print("  - The file exists")
        print("  - The path is correct")
        print("  - Any previous pipeline stages have completed successfully")
        print()
        print(
            "If you have left it too late before a deadline to ask for "
            "help resolving this issue, please include the missing "
            "artefact separately in your coursework submission."
        )
        return False

    return True
```

## Your task

## The Problem

Data on [Energy Certificates](https://epc.opendatacommunities.org/) were downloaded in March 2025. In this task, you are required to determine whether it is possible to determine the age of a house based on several recorded energy metrics.
